newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN DISTRIGAS SEES STABLE '97 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN DISTRIGAS SEES STABLE '97 EARNINGS.

text.p: Belgian natural gas distributor Distrigas said on Tuesday it was hoping for steady earnings and dividend in 1997 despite flagging sales in the first months.
"For results and dividend we see a fairly stable evolution," chief executive officer Jean-Pierre Depaemelaere told a news conference following the company's annual shareholders meeting.
"But overall sales have dropped by 10 percent in the first three months," he added.
He said this was mainly due to milder weather conditions in the first quarter compared with a year earlier.
"Now it remains to be seen whether it can be compensated by a (colder) last quarter," he said.
